outputs.explanation: Panel A is a 3D segmented/rendered model of pre-conoidal rings and actin nucleation (schematic/structural rendering), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a 3D segmented rendering of cytoplasmic actin bundles and IMC, a schematic/structural illustration, not a data plot.
Panel C is a tomographic slice image (micrograph) showing pellicular filaments, not a plot of averaged quantitative data.
Panel D is a schematic/3D rendered model of a lateral section of the sporozoite showing labeled structures, not a quantitative plot.
Panel E is a tomographic average volume slice (micrograph-type image), not a plot showing averages with error bars or summary statistics requiring individual points.
Panel F is a tomogram slice (micrograph) showing a filament connection, not a quantitative plot; the check for individual data points does not apply.
